acceptanceCriteria: A retained live Playwright full and isolated run exercises baseline record/diff and the gate's baseline filter.
A measured before/after count of repeated identical failing runs is retained, or the claim is withdrawn.
body: PR #1062 delivered TOL-V0-047..054 and PWR-V0-041..045 with fixture tests only. NOT_RUN: live Playwright full and isolated runs, and a measured reduction in repeated runs. `runs baseline record` reads kept reports and does not run the suite (recorded deviation).
title: Qualify preflight cache, failure-signature refusal and runs baseline on live Playwright runs (V1-1590/1594/1605 residual)
